description.value: The Bread Quarter is a neighbourhood artisan bakery in North Vancouver with over 40 years of continuous operation, now in its fourth ownership by a local family committed to preserving its traditions. The bakery specialises in naturally fermented sourdough using a wild starter said to be over 50 years old, alongside Persian Barbari flatbread, rye breads, and scratch-made buns produced fresh daily without preservatives. Touring cyclists passing through the Lower Lonsdale area can stock up on dense, calorie-rich breads and pastries well-suited to long days in the saddle.
